summary: No public author gene-level result was located for isoflurane versus oxygen in any of the three registered preoptic populations. All 180 GEO supplements were inspected: 60 count matrices, 60 feature lists and 60 barcode lists. The closest manuscript compares recovery sleep with undisturbed sleep. The proposal leaves author concordance unassessed.
openIssues: Assessing agreement requires a public author result that identifies the mouse cohort, cell population and treatment direction.
